findings.highlight: why she brought me here to the dojo
findings.evidenceJa: 人を道場に呼びつけて
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks why Rin summoned or called him out to the dojo.
findings.explanation: The English changes her summons into physically bringing him there.

findings.highlight: Shirou’s also in a lot of danger
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎だって負けず劣らずでやばい
findings.governingReading: Rin says Shirou is in danger no less serious than Sakura’s.
findings.explanation: The English preserves danger but removes the comparison that puts both of them at comparable risk.

findings.highlight: Don’t just stand there
findings.evidenceJa: ぽかんとしてないで
findings.governingReading: Rin tells the dumbfounded Shirou to stop gaping and remove his top.
findings.explanation: The English replaces his visible stunned reaction with generic inaction.

findings.highlight: Sakura’s stare is painful
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の視線が妙に痛い
findings.governingReading: Shirou feels Sakura’s gaze bearing on him with unusual accusatory force.
findings.explanation: The literal English produces unnatural idiom and obscures the social pressure of her look.

findings.highlight: if I’m going to go along with Tohsaka
findings.evidenceJa: 姉さんのところに行っちゃうんですか
findings.governingReading: Shirou reads Sakura’s eyes as asking whether he is going over to her older sister.
findings.explanation: The English changes a jealous relational movement toward Rin into agreement or compliance with her.

findings.highlight: You mean like this!?
findings.evidenceJa: こんなカッコウで遠坂の近くにか
findings.governingReading: Shirou protests at going close to Rin while dressed only from the waist down.
findings.explanation: The English retains embarrassment about his state but drops the crucial proximity to Rin.

findings.highlight: comprehend it
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎の肉感を把握して
findings.governingReading: Rin must directly feel and assess the physical substance or condition of Shirou’s body.
findings.explanation: The English replaces a tactile bodily assessment with an unclear pronoun and abstract comprehension.

findings.highlight: inscribe my warding crest on you
findings.evidenceJa: 魔よけの刻印を上書きする
findings.governingReading: Rin will overwrite the existing warding mark after assessing Shirou’s body.
findings.explanation: The English removes the overwrite operation and possessively recasts the warding mark as Rin’s crest.

findings.highlight: Sakura’s stare is more painful now
findings.evidenceJa: 痛い、気がする
findings.governingReading: Shirou tentatively feels that Sakura’s gaze seems more accusatory than before.
findings.explanation: The English removes his explicit uncertainty.

findings.highlight: It’s natural that I’m acting strange
findings.evidenceJa: そりゃ声だってうわずるし
findings.governingReading: Shirou says of course his voice would rise or go shrill in this situation.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes the specific involuntary vocal reaction into acting strange.

findings.highlight: Archer’s arm might flow magical energy into your body
findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーの腕から魔力が逆流してくる
findings.governingReading: Magical energy may unpredictably flow backward from Archer’s arm into Shirou’s unstable body.
findings.explanation: The English makes the arm itself perform the flowing and loses the technical backflow relation.

findings.highlight: unless you really want it to be
findings.evidenceJa: 全力で意識しないかぎり
findings.governingReading: The left arm will remain disconnected unless Shirou consciously concentrates on it with full effort.
findings.explanation: The English changes a deliberate act of concentration into merely wanting the connection.

findings.highlight: stop myself from jumping back
findings.evidenceJa: 後退しそうな足を必死に押し止める
findings.governingReading: Shirou desperately stops his feet just as they are about to recoil backward.
findings.explanation: The English changes a checked backward step into a jump and removes the bodily focus on his feet.

findings.highlight: transplant the Magic Crest from my arm
findings.evidenceJa: 左手から刻印を移す
findings.governingReading: Rin says she is transferring the marking from her left hand and cannot reduce its temperature further.
findings.explanation: The English changes hand to arm and elevates the local marking transfer into transplantation of the hereditary Magic Crest.

findings.highlight: sends a shudder through my heart
findings.evidenceJa: 心臓が壊れかねない
findings.governingReading: Shirou hyperbolically feels Rin’s soft contact could make his heart break down.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes a passing shudder for the comic sense of his heart being unable to withstand it.

findings.highlight: something rigid tears through my skin
findings.evidenceJa: 小さな棒みたいなものが、皮膚を通り抜けて
findings.governingReading: Shirou feels something like a small rod pass through his skin into his body.
findings.explanation: The English removes the small rod comparison and adds violent tearing, despite Rin’s assurance that the process leaves no wound.

findings.highlight: something like that
findings.evidenceJa: いけないコトって
findings.governingReading: Shirou reacts specifically to Rin calling the procedure something improper or forbidden-sounding.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes away the phrase that drives his further embarrassment.

findings.highlight: really love to run away right now
findings.evidenceJa: 脱兎の如く逃げ出したい
findings.governingReading: Shirou wants to bolt away like a startled rabbit.
findings.explanation: The English preserves the wish to flee but removes the comic speed and animal image.

findings.highlight: seem like I’m conscious of Tohsaka
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂を意識しているようで
findings.governingReading: Fleeing would make Shirou appear even more romantically self-conscious about Rin.
findings.explanation: The English copies the Japanese expression into unnatural wording that does not clearly convey romantic awareness.

findings.highlight: Come on
findings.evidenceJa: ちゃんと胸張ってよ
findings.governingReading: Rin tells Shirou to hold his chest out properly for the shoulder procedure.
findings.explanation: The English omits the concrete posture instruction.

findings.highlight: so suck it up
findings.evidenceJa: 今度は頑張ってよね
findings.governingReading: Rin tells Shirou to make an effort and endure the next stage.
findings.explanation: The English adds a harsher dismissive command and shifts Rin’s procedural encouragement.

findings.highlight: her bag
findings.evidenceJa: ボストンバッグ
findings.governingReading: Rin walks toward the corner containing her Boston bag.
findings.explanation: The English again removes the concrete type of bag.

findings.highlight: calm down and take a deep breath
findings.evidenceJa: 落ち着いて呼吸ができた
findings.governingReading: Shirou finally calms enough to breathe normally again.
findings.explanation: The English replaces regained breathing with one deliberate deep breath.

findings.highlight: looking like she wants to say something
findings.evidenceJa: 視線を逸らし
findings.governingReading: Sakura averts her gaze while fidgeting as though she wants to say something.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the apparent wish to speak but removes her evasive gaze.

findings.highlight: takes a look at me
findings.evidenceJa: こっちの顔色を窺う
findings.governingReading: Sakura glances over to gauge Shirou’s expression or reaction.
findings.explanation: The English reduces her anxious social checking to an ordinary look.

findings.highlight: please bear with it
findings.evidenceJa: 我慢してくださいっ
findings.governingReading: Sakura asks Shirou to restrain or control his flustered reaction because he is her boyfriend.
findings.explanation: The English makes her appear to ask him to tolerate the situation instead, reversing who must control what.

findings.highlight: I’ll do my best not to lose my composure
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂にドキマギしないよう、頑張る
findings.governingReading: Shirou promises to try not to become flustered specifically around Rin.
findings.explanation: The English removes Rin as the target and turns the relationship-specific promise into generic composure.

findings.highlight: a really stressful thing
findings.evidenceJa: すごく緊張するコト
findings.governingReading: Shirou realizes that living under one roof with three girls may make him extremely nervous or tense.
findings.explanation: The English shifts his comic internal nervousness into a generic judgment that the arrangement is stressful.
